notes: Constructs a TestNG SkipException into a local variable at the start of testUnknownEntriesWithFailures and throws the variable whenever the CI environment variable is set: final org.testng.SkipException flaky = new org.testng.SkipException("Flaky, see https://github.com/killbill/killbill/issues/860"); if (System.getenv("CI") != null) { throw flaky; }. TestNG reports the test as skipped. Rejected with disable/assumption_added: a thrown SkipException outside a catch is a disable whether the throw names the exception or a variable holding it, so a checker that matches only throw new SkipException(...) misses it. The code is the same as reject-testng-skip-exception-thrown, which reports only disable/assumption_added for a thrown SkipException, and this fixture follows it. Adapted: built on reject-testng-skip-exception-thrown (the killbill commit of reject-testng-retry-analyzer); the four added lines are hand written on its pre image, with the message the commit itself uses, and every context line is the pre image's own.
